scope: Desktop WSL software GLES2, Proving Grounds split screen, Quit Race to Summary, Lap Times, and Main at 1180x820.
method: Test-only link wrapper read every RGB pixel in the default framebuffer immediately before swapping. Swaps were matched to the application presentation trace.
result: All three original-route frames were fully black. Authored step zero was black and the following step revealed the leading edge. The process exited cleanly after starting a second race.
limitation: Physical iPad and full-frame capture of the natural finish were not verified. Earlier probe used GLES3 queries on GLES2 and its results were discarded.
